raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Batch 13 (377 rows, ingested 2026-01-18) arrived with txn_ts in UTC (source_tz='UTC') while every other batch is in America/Chicago local time. Its sample rows start at 12:02 UTC, which is 06:02 CST. Silver casts txn_ts without converting it, so Jan 17 evening transactions (18:00-23:00 CST) land on 2026-01-18 between 00:00 and 05:00, and txn_date is wrong for them.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.85, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CASE WHEN source_tz = 'UTC' THEN CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) - INTERVAL 6 HOUR ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS txn_ts, CAST(CASE WHEN source_tz = 'UTC' THEN CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) - INTERVAL 6 HOUR ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED';"}}
